notice.encryption-key-invalid: This DiveDay instance’s encryption key is misconfigured, so nothing was saved.

common.notAvailableAsk: More integrations come later. Ask us at {email}.

shopify.name: Shopify
shopify.description: Publishes your priced rentals and dive packages as Shopify products.
shopify.domainDescription: Use the store’s myshopify.com domain. DiveDay only asks for product write access.
shopify.syncDescription: Only priced rentals and active dive packages are sent. Products are tagged as managed by DiveDay.
shopify.notConnected: No Shopify store is connected yet.

quickbooks.name: QuickBooks Online
quickbooks.description: Sends paid orders and refunds to QuickBooks as sales receipts.
quickbooks.incomeAccountDescription: The QuickBooks income account used by the DiveDay sales item. Find its numeric ID in QuickBooks.
quickbooks.notConnected: No QuickBooks company is connected yet.
quickbooks.setupRequired: Connect a company and set its income account before paid orders can sync.

zapier.name: Zapier
zapier.description: Sends the order events you pick to a Zapier Catch Hook.
zapier.webhookDescription: Treat this URL like a password. It is sealed in DiveDay and never shown again after saving.
zapier.notConnected: No Zapier Catch Hook is connected yet.
zapier.eventsDescription: Choose which order events this Zap should receive.

earlier.heading: Send earlier checkouts
earlier.description: Hand a connected provider the card checkouts, tips and refunds from before it was connected. Nothing goes out until you confirm, and anything it already has is skipped.
earlier.sinceDescription: A day in {timezone}. Everything completed on or after it.
earlier.previewLine: Since {date}: {checkouts, plural, one {# checkout} other {# checkouts}}, {tips, plural, one {# tip} other {# tips}} and {refunds, plural, one {# refund} other {# refunds}} have not reached {provider}.
earlier.previewNothing: Nothing since {date} is waiting to be sent to {provider}.
earlier.caution: They arrive in {provider} as new entries, oldest first. If that period is closed in your books, do not send them.

square.name: Square
square.description: Match Square receipts to purchases you already recorded. Square takes the payment; DiveDay records it once.
square.locationHelp: Choose the location for this shop. Only locations using the shop’s currency appear.
square.noLocations: No active Square location uses this shop’s currency.
square.unavailable: Square could not be reached. Try again or reconnect.
square.receiptHelp: Link a payment already recorded here. This does not take payment, change the purchase, or add another DiveDay fee.
square.paymentIdHelp: Use the payment ID, not the short receipt number. One payment can link to one purchase.
square.needsCheck: The Square receipt and this purchase differ. Check the receipt and any refunds before checking again.

outcome.matched: Receipt matched. The purchase and DiveDay fee are unchanged.
outcome.not_connected: Connect Square and choose a location in Settings → Integrations first.
outcome.unavailable: The payment could not be read. Check the payment ID or reconnect Square, then try again.
outcome.invalid: This purchase cannot be matched to a Square receipt.
outcome.already_linked: That payment or purchase already has a receipt link. No purchase or fee was added.
outcome.not_completed: Square has not completed this payment. Nothing changed here.
outcome.location_mismatch: This payment belongs to a different Square location. Nothing changed here.
outcome.amount_mismatch: The currency, original total, or tip differs. Check the purchase and Square receipt. Nothing changed here.
outcome.refund_mismatch: Square and DiveDay show different refund totals. Record money already returned in DiveDay, or check the refund in Square, then check again.
outcome.deleted: Receipt link deleted. The purchase, refund record and DiveDay fee are unchanged.
